title: TrustLine
tagline: TrustLine lets AI agents privately verify solvency and automatically settle deals onchain.
description: TrustLine is a trust and payment layer for autonomous AI agents. Before an agent pays for a deal, TrustLine privately verifies whether the agent can cover the required amount without revealing its wallet balance. Chainlink CRE handles the confidential solvency logic, while Privy provides a policy-controlled wallet for automated settlement. Bazantic makes the capability discoverable and callable by other agents through an x402-enabled service. If the private check returns SETTLE, the approved wallet can release the exact deal amount to the counterparty; if it returns INSUFFICIENT, payment is blocked. Our MVP demonstrates the complete orchestration on Base Sepolia, with the confidential CRE computation currently simulated locally due to CRE access constraints.
how_its_made: TrustLine combines Bazantic, Chainlink CRE, Privy, and Base Sepolia into one agent-to-agent payment flow. An AI agent calls TrustLine through the Bazantic/x402 interface with a deal amount and reference ID. The backend passes the request to our solvency-check workflow, which determines whether the wallet can cover the deal without exposing its actual balance. A SETTLE result triggers the Privy policy-controlled wallet to authorize the payment, while INSUFFICIENT stops the flow. We use BigInt-based amount handling and reference IDs to prevent rounding errors and duplicate payments. The MVP uses a local simulation of the Chainlink confidential execution environment, while the wallet settlement path is designed for real Base Sepolia transactions.
auto_summary: TrustLine verifies an agent’s ability to pay privately and conditionally triggers wallet-based settlement for agent-to-agent deals.
